description: This file defines the NoteService class which encapsulates CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for 'Note' objects within a Spring-based backend application. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and seeding notes stored via a NoteRepository.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: A service class annotated with @Service and @Transactional, providing CRUD operations and seed functionality for notes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and persists a new Note from the provided request payload.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes from the repository.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, throwing NotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID using the provided request payload.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID, throwing NotFoundException if the note does not exist.

methods.name: seedIfEmpty
methods.description: Seeds the repository with sample notes if it is currently empty.
